newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Punished Russian sailor dies of suffocation.
newsitem.headline: Punished Russian sailor dies of suffocation.

text.p: A Russian sailor died of suffocation after his commander locked him up for several hours inside a cramped missile shaft, NTV commercial television said.
In the latest tragedy to hit Russia's badly demoralised Pacific Fleet, NTV said late on Friday that the sailor, Alexander Kim, had been punished for not carrying out his duties properly.
It did not say when the incident happened and officials in the port city of Vladivostok, home of the Pacific Fleet, were not available on Saturday to confirm the report.
NTV said the military prosecutor had launched criminal proceedings against the officer concerned.

Once a proud emblem of Soviet military might, the Pacific Fleet has seen a big drop in funding and morale in recent years. Officers often go many months without pay and brutal bullying of young conscripts has become commonplace.
